features.heading: AI-Powered SEO, Built for Small Business Reality
features.intro: Search Engine Optimization gives your SMB customers enterprise-level ranking capability with small-business simplicity. Every tool is designed to remove complexity while delivering measurable results across organic search.

cards.title: AI-Powered SEO Strategy
cards.body: A clear, actionable SEO roadmap generated automatically for every customer. Weekly, bite-sized tasks replace vague recommendations — so owners make progress without needing an expert.

cards.title: AI Keyword Discovery & Tracking
cards.body: Uncover high-intent keywords tailored to each customer's industry and location. Live tracking shows ranking movement, trend direction, and competitive share of voice.

cards.title: AI Content Creation
cards.body: Generate SEO-friendly blog posts, service pages, and product descriptions in minutes. Content is keyword-targeted, on-brand, and ready to publish without a copywriter.

cards.title: Website Optimization
cards.body: Technical SEO turned into plain-English steps. AI scans every page and prioritizes fixes by impact — from meta tags and headings to speed, structure, and content depth.

cards.title: Performance Tracking & Intelligence
cards.body: A single dashboard for rankings, organic traffic, top pages, and competitor benchmarks. Owners see progress at a glance; partners see a retention story they can sell.

cards.title: Local SEO Visibility
cards.body: Google Business Profile optimization, local pack monitoring, and location-based keyword tracking — purpose-built for SMBs who win or lose on local search.

partnerAdvantage.heading: The Recurring Revenue Engine Your Portfolio Is Missing
partnerAdvantage.intro: SEO solves a problem every SMB has, generates measurable results, and creates one of the strongest renewal stories in digital services.

items.title: Higher revenue potential with a premium product
items.body: SEO commands higher ARPU than basic digital services and gives partners a clear, differentiated offering that justifies its price — rankings, traffic, and leads the customer can see.

items.title: Ranking progress creates strong retention
items.body: SEO compounds over time. The longer a customer stays, the more they have to lose by leaving — which makes SEO one of the stickiest subscription products in the portfolio.

items.title: Full-service digital marketing capability
items.body: Combined with listings, reputation, and advertising, SEO completes a true marketing stack — positioning you as the partner SMBs grow with, not just a utility provider.

items.title: Clear value proposition for growing businesses
items.body: SMBs that are past "getting online" and focused on "getting found" know they need SEO. You meet them exactly where they are — with a ready-to-sell, ready-to-deliver solution.

lifecycleFit.heading: The Engine Behind Every High-Growth SMB
lifecycleFit.intro: SEO is the product SMBs invest in once they're serious about growth. It sits in the Get Found motion — alongside listings and reputation — and sets up the natural upgrade to Marketing 360.
